items.title: Aptiv (APTV) Stock May Look Reasonable As Earnings Risk Stays In Focus
items.summary: Aptiv stock trades near US$47.95 after a steep multi year decline, and the valuation checks now offer a mixed picture rather than a clear bargain or clear overpricing. items.title: What Are You Actually Buying In Aurora Innovation Stock?
items.summary: Aurora Innovation (AUR) trades at about $6.30 a share, a market value of about $12.5 billion, on $2 million of revenue in the second quarter of 2026. The stock trades at 2,498 times trailing twelve-month sales against 3.2 for the S&P 500. The multiple is not measuring anything. What you are buying is a truck count and the rate each truck earns.
